intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre school lunch.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about school lunch.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Today’s lunch menu has three choices. Students can have vegetable soup with bread, chicken rice with salad, or a cheese sandwich with an apple. Water is free. Ask the kitchen team about allergies before you choose. Lunch starts at twelve and finishes at one thirty. Students who bring a lunchbox should sit at the tables near the library.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Today’s lunch menu has three choices. Students can have vegetable soup with bread, chicken rice with salad, or a cheese sandwich with an apple. Water is free. Ask the kitchen team about allergies before you choose. Lunch starts at twelve and finishes at one thirty. Students who bring a lunchbox should sit at the tables near the library.
